question: Will Kai and Speed beat the Minecraft challenge by August 17?
resolution_criteria:
Kai Cenat and IShowSpeed are scheduled to stream a hardcore Minecraft marathon on August 7, 2026, at 5:00 PM ET. They will attempt a challenge to defeat the Ender Dragon, the Wither, the Warden, and the Elder Guardian in a hardcore Minecraft world on Java Edition, on the same seed, without either player dying in-game. 

This market will resolve to "Yes" if Kai and Speed complete the aforementioned challenge live on stream between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

All four objectives must be completed on the same seed and in the same world. Progress across multiple seeds will not be combined.

Any successful attempt within the specified timeframe will qualify; however, no challenge progress may be carried over following an in-game death and the beginning of a new attempt. 

Practice or casual worlds not set to Hardcore will not count. No event will count if it occurs while the player in question is in Creative or Spectator mode, or if it results from the use of commands, cheats, or any external tool to spawn entities, alter the world, or deal damage.

Only completion of the challenge as defined above will qualify. If Kai and Speed modify the rules of the challenge at any point, including by removing an objective, adding a player, or playing outside of Hardcore mode, any completion achieved under the modified rules will not count toward resolution.

Only events occurring while at least one of the two players is broadcasting the challenge live will count. Footage of off-stream or previously recorded attempts will not qualify.

If the challenge is cancelled by, abandoned before completion by, or delayed to a point after the specified date, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be footage from the official broadcasts of the challenge on Kai Cenat's and IShowSpeed's official broadcasts on YouTube and Twitch.
research:
I couldn't find anything dated on or before 2026-08-10 that settles this question. On the morning of Aug 9, the pair had about 48 hours of play, 31 deaths and no boss progress. Several pages surfaced in searches are clearly dated after the cutoff and report the outcome. I ignored them as instructed. Direct page fetches failed through the proxy, so the facts below come from search-result snippets.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is the live broadcast footage on Kai Cenat's Twitch and IShowSpeed's YouTube. Neither channel could be checked directly, and I found no status page with a boss checklist dated on or before Aug 10.
- 2026-08-05: Kai Cenat announced: "Kai X Speed Minecraft Marathon Can't get off until we BEAT Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian & Ender Dragon ON HARDCORE." [X/KaiCenat](https://x.com/KaiCenat/status/2085043651516780873)

## 2. Current status (as of the Aug 10 cutoff)
- 2026-08-09 (per the search snippet): a Speed fan account posted "Speed & Kai have officially played 48 hours of Minecraft Hardcore and made 0% progress so far 😭 31 total deaths: Speed 20 | Kai 11." [X/SpeedUpdates1](https://x.com/SpeedUpdates1/status/2086559876629848399)
- Dot Esports ran a "Speed racks up 25 deaths" story during the marathon, before the 31-death post. I couldn't open it to confirm the date. [Dot Esports](https://dotesports.com/streaming/news/speed-kai-minecraft-hardcore-bosses-25-deaths)
- Sportskeeda covered Speed getting emotional when Kai died in lava about 40 hours in. [Sportskeeda](https://sportskeeda.com/us/streamers/news-why-that-ishowspeed-gets-emotional-kai-cenat-dies-lava-40-hours-hardcore-minecraft-marathon)
- Bottom line: the latest status I could find is about 48 hours played, 31 deaths, and no bosses killed on the current seed. The stream was a "can't get off until we beat it" marathon, and nothing showed it was cancelled or paused.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-09: 48 hours played, 31 deaths, 0% progress (see above). [X/SpeedUpdates1](https://x.com/SpeedUpdates1/status/2086559876629848399)
- About 2026-08-08: TikTok clips show both players dying after a raid farm broke and a Vex escaped. [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@thestreamingplug5/video/7672776273348906260)
- 2026-08-07: The marathon started around 5 PM ET, with Kai on Twitch and Speed on YouTube. One death resets the world. [Shane the Gamer](https://www.shanethegamer.com/news/ishowspeed-kai-cenat-minecraft-hardcore-stream-start-time/), [bo3.gg](https://bo3.gg/games/news/ishowspeed-and-kai-cenat-start-minecraft-hardcore-marathon-without-deaths)
- 2026-08-06: A pro Minecraft player warned the stream "may never end." [UNILAD Tech](https://www.uniladtech.com/social-media/kai-cenat-ishowspeed-stream-minecraft-pro-never-end-072808-20260806)

## 4. Base rates
- In their 2024 hardcore collab, the goal was only the Ender Dragon. It reportedly took about 106 hours of streaming spread over several days. [UNILAD Tech](https://www.uniladtech.com/social-media/kai-cenat-ishowspeed-stream-minecraft-pro-never-end-072808-20260806)
- The 2026 challenge adds three bosses. The Warden and Elder Guardian in particular are dangerous for weak players and slow to prepare for, since they need gear, potions and an ocean monument. That makes a full clear take longer than a dragon-only run.
- The deadline is Aug 17, so they have about 10 days from the start. If they needed more than 106 hours for the dragon alone in 2024, the 2026 goal would plausibly take something like 100 to 150 or more hours. That could fit inside 10 days if they stream almost nonstop, as the "can't get off" pledge suggests. The death rate so far (31 in 48 hours, about one reset every 1.5 hours) shows how fragile each run was. This range is my own rough reasoning from the 2024 figure, not a sourced estimate.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-08-08 07:34 GMT: Polymarket's "beat by August 12" market traded around 5% YES. [orrery.me mirror](https://orrery.me/markets/will-kai-and-speed-beat-the-minecraft-challenge-by-august-12-20260807213124701)
- Around 2026-08-08: the "by August 14" market traded around 6¢, with about $24.9K volume. [orrery.me mirror](https://orrery.me/markets/will-kai-and-speed-beat-the-minecraft-challenge-by-august-14-20260807213124703)
- Polymarket's multi-date event page: [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/kai-and-speed-beat-minecraft-challenge-byptptpt-20260807141254095). I couldn't get the August 17 price from on or before Aug 10.
- A related market on "90 or more total deaths" traded around 83¢ in one snapshot (date unclear). [orrery.me](https://orrery.me/markets/will-kai-and-speed-have-90-or-more-total-in-game-deaths-during-their-minecraft-marathon-20260807054442845)
- Some digitechbytes pages claim Polymarket showed 100% YES. They are AI-generated and look unreliable, so I ignored them.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The marathon was set to keep going until the challenge is beaten, so it should run continuously through the Aug 17 deadline unless the streamers stop.
- Things that could change the outcome:
  - deaths that reset the world
  - stopping because of fatigue or sleep breaks
  - any change to the rules, such as dropping Hardcore or adding a helper, which would make a completion not count.
- Off-stream play doesn't count, so pauses between streams matter.

- **Yes:** Speed and Kai adopt much safer play, perhaps with heavy coaching. One run survives about a day. They gear up, use cheese strategies on the Warden and Elder Guardian, and finish everything around Aug 14 to 16.

The Aug 9 data showing no progress at the 48-hour mark is somewhat negative and may not have been fully reflected in those Aug 8 prices. The extra days to Aug 17 add a little probability. I settle slightly below the implied anchor, at about 7%.

Probability: 7%
